title: 第8章 驱狼吞虎，借刀杀人
novel_title: 九恶妃每日一问，陛下驾崩了吗？
content_zh:
“青符，那盘肉看着不错，给朕端到面前来。”

    秦然拿着筷子，随手指向了摆在唐梦宫面前的一盘肉。

    肉色呈金黄，上面挂着如玉般晶莹的汤汁，餐盘上还笼罩着一层氤氲薄雾。

    看起来十分美味。

    “是，陛下。”

    青符瞄了眼餐桌上的摆盘，数十道菜将整个桌子摆得满满的。

    想要把肉菜端到秦然面前，那势必要将秦然面前的一盘菜挪走，换个地方。

    于是，他抬手将秦然面前的冰心糖藕挪开，与唐梦宫面前的肉菜互换了个位置……

    两道菜互换位置，只是微不足道的小事。

    但在冰心糖藕放到面前时，原本就心情不悦的唐梦宫直接暴走了。

    因为，她从小到大唯一受伤的一次，便是被一株藕妖偷袭。

    所以，“藕”是她最厌恶之物。

    啪！

    她一挥袖子，面前的冰心糖藕直接被摔落在地，清脆声响在大殿内格外刺耳。

    噗通！噗通！！

    一瞬间，周围的太监宫女们吓得跪了一地。

    “梦宫，怎么了？”

    秦然担忧地上前，一脸的心疼之色。

    唐梦宫美眸中泛着森然寒光。

    “本小姐不喜欢莲藕！”

    秦然强忍心中笑意，被酒色掏空的苍白脸上，露出极度愤怒之色。

    “你们这些狗奴才，不知道梦宫不喜欢莲藕吗？你们都是干什么吃的！！”

    他愤怒咆哮，手一挥，眼前酒水餐食噼里啪啦地散落一地。

    周围地上的太监宫女们更慌了，一个个吓得面无血色。

    这个沉迷酒色的昏庸帝君，往日的残忍手段，他们可都是领教过的……

    “求陛下恕罪！”

    “求梦妃娘娘恕罪！！”

    大殿里一片求饶声。

    青符也在一旁跪着磕头，“求陛下恕罪，是奴才……”

    “滚！！”

    秦然沉声怒骂，一脚踹在了青符脸上。

    后者面色阴冷，但这种时刻也只能顺着来，借力扑通一声滚在了地上，模样十分狼狈。

    秦然扫视着跪落一地的太监。

    最终，目光锁定在了一个负责御膳房的太监总管身上。

    他拎起桌上酒壶，脚步虚浮，衣衫半敞地朝太监总管走去。

    后者见状，脑袋砰砰砰地用力撞着地面。

    “陛下恕罪，一切都是奴才的错！”

    “陛下恕罪！！”

    砰！！

    秦然一脚将太监总管踹翻在地。
content_en:
"Qing Fu, that plate of meat looks good. Bring it to me."

Qin Ran took the chopsticks and pointed at the plate of meat placed in front of Tang Menggong.

The meat is golden in color, with a jade-like soup hanging on it, and a layer of mist hangs over the dinner plate.

Looks absolutely delicious.

"Yes, Your Majesty."

Qing Fu glanced at the plates on the dining table. Dozens of dishes filled the entire table.

If he wanted to bring the meat and vegetables in front of Kieran, he would have to move the plate of food in front of Kieran and change it to another place.

So, he raised his hand to move the sweetened lotus root in front of Qin Ran and exchanged places with the meat and vegetables in front of Tang Menggong...

It was just a trivial matter that the two dishes swapped places.

But when the Bing Xin Tang Lotus Root was placed in front of him, Tang Menggong, who was already unhappy, ran away.

Because the only time she was injured since she was a child was when she was attacked by a lotus root demon.

Therefore, "lotus root" is the thing she hates the most.

Snap!

She waved her sleeves, and the Bing Xin Tang Lotus Root in front of her was thrown to the ground, and the crisp sound was particularly harsh in the hall.

Plop!Plop!!

In an instant, the surrounding eunuchs and maids were so frightened that they knelt on the ground.

"Meng Palace, what's wrong?"

Qin Ran stepped forward worriedly, with a distressed look on his face.

Tang Menggong's beautiful eyes glowed with a cold light.

"I don't like lotus roots!"

Qin Ran suppressed the laughter in his heart, and his pale face, hollowed out by the wine, revealed a look of extreme anger.

"You dog slaves, don't you know that Meng Gong doesn't like lotus roots? What do you do to eat!!"

He roared angrily, waved his hand, and the food and drinks were scattered all over the floor in front of him.

The eunuchs and maids on the ground around them were even more panicked, their faces turned pale with fear.

They have all experienced the cruel methods of this fatuous emperor addicted to alcohol and sex...

"Please forgive me, Your Majesty!"

"Please forgive me, Empress Mengfei!!"

There was a cry for mercy in the hall.

Qing Fu also knelt down and kowtowed, "Your Majesty, please forgive me. I am a slave..."

"Get out!!"

Qin Ran cursed in a deep voice and kicked Qing Fu in the face.

The latter's expression was gloomy, but he could only go along with it at this moment, and rolled to the ground with a plop, looking very embarrassed.

Qin Ran glanced at the eunuch who was kneeling on the ground.

Finally, his eyes were fixed on a head eunuch in charge of the imperial kitchen.

He picked up the wine bottle on the table, walked toward the head eunuch with his steps empty, and his clothes half-undressed.

When the latter saw this, his head banged against the ground hard.

"Your Majesty, forgive me, everything is my slave's fault!"

"Your Majesty, forgive me!!"

Bang!!

Qin Ran kicked the chief eunuch to the ground.
